post_ship_review.fix: 12 precise edits: (1) §2.2 T=1 image/video-share-latent-space reasoning corrected (symmetric-pad VAE can mechanically run T=1 but falls outside the training distribution, not literally 'looks at the future'); (2) §3.3 added a caveat that Sora's RoPE-2D/RoPE-1D/aspect-ratio-token implementation details are community speculation, not disclosed fact — resolves the self-contradiction with §3.4/§4.1's own 'speculated' framing; (3) TL;DR item 5 — Wan 2.x uses conventional cross-attention to UMT5, not joint-stream MM-DiT like Hunyuan-Video/Mochi; (4) Movie Gen corrected from one 30B joint model to two separate models (Video 30B + Audio 13B) in both the timeline table and §A.4 SoTA table; (5) §6.1 SVD corrected from a mask-based (2C+1)-channel concat to its actual 4+4=8-channel latent concat + CLIP cross-attention (no mask channel); (6) §6.2 removed an incorrect AnimateDiff attribution to ref-image cross-attention (AnimateDiff has no ref-image conditioning); (7) Q12 'factorized is a strict subset of full 3D' softened from a set-theoretic claim to an inductive-bias / 2-hop-composition explanation; (8) Q13 LTX-Video compression recalculated from the tutorial's own formula: true scalar compression ≈1:192 (via ~128 latent channels), not 1:8192 (a token-count figure); (9) §5.5 + code comment: RF's τ=0=noise/τ=1=data convention relabeled as SD3-equivalent-via-time-reversal rather than 'consistent with SD3' (SD3 itself uses t=0=data / t=1=noise); (10) Random latent decode sanity check corrected — first-stage video VAEs use near-zero KL weight so N(0,I) decode is not a valid degeneration check; (11) Q25 DDPM ε-pred target-scale claim corrected (both the bullet and the closing summary line) — target ε~N(0,I) is t-independent by construction, matching RF's u_τ; the real t-dependence lives in SNR/reweighting, not target scale; (12) §10.2 Hunyuan-Video PFLOP/sample recomputed from the article's own §10.1 formula and largest-spec numbers: tens of PFLOP/sample, not 'several hundred to a thousand'.
post_ship_review.note: Two-stage cross-model audit: Codex GPT-5.6-sol (ultra reasoning) proposed 12 candidate findings from a fresh read; an independent Claude thread then adversarially attempted to refute every one (explicitly instructed to try to overturn each claim) before any fix was applied. Result: 9 CONFIRMED as-is, 3 upgraded to NEEDS_NUANCE (the underlying issue was real but the ledger's initial framing was too strong / imprecise) — all 12 applied with the nuanced fix text. No new content introduced beyond what the fix_text specified; math/code review and render review from prior rounds remain valid on top of these corrections.
